name: 22043 · Falls Church, VA
findings: ZIP 22043 (Falls Church) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22043 (Falls Church) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
